Thanks all 

A quick technical note and proposed success criteria to make the kickoff productive: please confirm the following owners join the kickoff (or delegate):
- Network/Infra owner (Acme)  to validate firewall rules and egress
- Application owner (Acme)  to validate integration points
- Procurement (Acme)  for billing/MOP sign-off

Proposed success criteria (short):
1) Confirm connectivity and required ports between Acme and Redwood test environment
2) Run a sample workload and validate latency/throughput meets the agreed baseline in the MOP
3) Agree on next-step rollout plan and owner assignments + dates

I'll attach a 1-page runbook to the invite and open time for deeper technical follow-ups after kickoff.

Rafael
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
